name: synthetic-pv-mppt-short
title: Synthetic PV panel in MPPT
purpose: The ideal 40 V source is replaced by a synthetic single-diode PV panel (57 W) and a 2.8 kΩ bus load; MPPT from t = 0. Integration check of the PV source and of the MPPT coupling over short runs; it does not judge tracking efficiency.
